sqlMap.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM ORDERS O INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE O.STATUS = #status#
SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, O.ORDER_ID FROM CUSTOMER C LEFT JOIN ORDERS O ON O.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID AND O.STATUS != 'CANCELLED'
SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, CAT.CATEGORY_NAME FROM PRODUCT P RIGHT JOIN CATEGORY CAT ON CAT.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID
SELECT S.SUPPLIER_ID, P.PRODUCT_ID FROM SUPPLIER S FULL OUTER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.SUPPLIER_ID = S.SUPPLIER_ID
SELECT R.REGION_CODE, CH.CHANNEL_CODE FROM REGION R CROSS JOIN CHANNEL CH
SELECT CH.CATEGORY_ID, CH.CATEGORY_NAME, PAR.CATEGORY_NAME AS PARENT_NAME FROM CATEGORY CH LEFT JOIN CATEGORY PAR ON PAR.CATEGORY_ID = CH.PARENT_ID WHERE CH.CATEGORY_ID = #categoryId#

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, P.PRODUCT_NAME, CAT.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUPPLIER_NAME, OD.QUANTITY FROM ORDERS O INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN ORDER_DETAIL OD ON OD.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OD.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORY CAT ON CAT.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN SUPPLIER S ON S.SUPPLIER_ID = P.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_DATE >= #since#
SELECT O.ORDER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM ORDERS O, CUSTOMER C WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID AND O.STATUS = #status#
